_l=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n");_c=_l[0].split()
MAT=np.array([[int(v) for v in r.split()[1:]] for r in _l[1:]],float); IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(_c)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,IDX['X']) for c in s])
NEG=-1e9
def nw_vec(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2);n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);M[0,0]=0.
    Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        s=MAT[e1[i-1],e2]
        M[i,1:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:m],Ix[i-1,:m]),Iy[i-1,:m])+s
        Ix[i,:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:]+go,Ix[i-1,:]+ge),Iy[i-1,:]+go)
        G=np.maximum.accumulate(np.maximum(M[i,:]+go,Ix[i,:]+go)-ge*jj)
        Iy[i,1:]=ge*(jj[1:]-1)+G[:m]
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0:
            s=MAT[e1[i-1],e2[j-1]];c=[M[i-1,j-1]+s,Ix[i-1,j-1]+s,Iy[i-1,j-1]+s]
            ns=int(np.argmin([abs(M[i,j]-x) for x in c]));A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1:
            c=[M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go]
            ns=int(np.argmin([abs(Ix[i,j]-x) for x in c]));A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1;st=ns
        else:
            c=[M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge]
            ns=int(np.argmin([abs(Iy[i,j]-x) for x in c]));A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;st=ns
    return ''.join(reversed(A)),''.join(reversed(B))
AA3=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVM"))
def parse(t):
    ch=defaultdict(dict);order=defaultdict(list);het=[]
    for ln in t.split("\n"):
        rec=ln[:6]
        if rec in ("ATOM  ","HETATM"):
            if ln[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            rn=ln[17:20].strip();c=ln[21];ri=ln[22:27].strip();nm=ln[12:16].strip()
            try: xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
            except: continue
            if rec=="ATOM  " or rn=="MSE":
                aa=AA3.get(rn)
                if aa is None: continue
                k=(c,ri)
                if k not in ch[c]: ch[c][k]={'aa':aa,'atoms':{}};order[c].append(k)
                ch[c][k]['atoms'][nm]=xyz
            elif rn!="HOH": het.append({'resn':rn,'ch':c,'ri':ri,'name':nm,'xyz':xyz})
    return ch,order,het

afCA={int(k[1]):afch['A'][k]['atoms']['CA'] for k in aford['A']}
apCA={int(k[1]):ch['A'][k]['atoms']['CA'] for k in order['A'] if 'CA' in ch['A'][k]['atoms']}
def kab(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
pr=[(a,b) for a,b in ap2ac.items() if a in apCA and b in afCA];cur=list(pr)
for _ in range(8):
    P=np.array([afCA[b] for a,b in cur]);Q=np.array([apCA[a] for a,b in cur]);R,t=kab(P,Q)
    d=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1);keep=d<max(3.0,np.percentile(d,80))
    if keep.sum()<60: break
    cur=[c for c,k in zip(cur,keep) if k]
P=np.array([afCA[b] for a,b in cur]);Q=np.array([apCA[a] for a,b in cur]);R,t=kab(P,Q)
rms=np.sqrt(((((R@P.T).T+t)-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())
